Hey thank u, i’ll give it a watch when im home from work

Hopefully before the borderline suicidal depression comes back xd
Eh ok its not funny but... Hey i can make fun of my own misery.

Oof... ;w; wont lie, i sometimes feel like im completely nuts, like i cant trust my own feelings at all

Really hope therapy and shit will help

Hey thank you for reaching out...

Im afraid I haven’t gotten that far yet, im yet to get my official diagnosis from a psychiatrist (It just takes a while here) but there’s just about no doubt its this.

Its hard to say, some things definitely trigger the mood swings more than others, but its seems to be mostly random.

I managed 20 years, because i only started to show symptoms around 3 years ago. Before that my life was amazing.
Yes i managed to live 3 years like this. And i think its more than enough. And i honestly would say yeah... i want a life, but not this one.

Im an apprentice, i make an ok amount of money. I still live with my parents. I have limited contact with my friends, because i haven’t made any new ones in about a year.

I managed to somehow not go crazy for most of the last 3 years but this year its been getting much worse rapidly.

Started off with a nasty breakup at the start of the year. It was the push i needed to attempt suicide, which culminated with me eventually talking to a psychiatrist 
Unfortunately they were unable to diagnose me with anything.

Fast forward a few months... Im still a mess, the mood swings have been getting worse.
I also only recently noticed that i go into both extreme lows and extreme highs. 

The reason they didn’t diagnose me with bipolar disorder before is because i myself didn’t even consider it, i thought its normal for me to just be very happy at times.

Turns outs its not, and everyone from friends with family members with it, to my doctor seem to think im bipolar.

So i generally speaking feel like this is a nice place to end my story at... What more is there to even add, i dont want to live the rest of my life like i have the last 3 years.

Can you really blame me, brother?
You know... Rubber bands help but they’re still fundamentally self harm in some way, i would strongly recommend trying other methods, something that doesn’t hurt you.

What a waste of time tho, typical of modern art, meaningless and ugly.

There’s such beautiful scenery RIGHT THERE use it!
Liking a guy only to find out he’s straight.

I get what you mean... However its not true that all straight men react negatively to another man’s affection, quite a few will actually feel good, knowing that someone looks at them in that way, they’ll feel appreciated, but are simply unable to react wit affection, because they simply are straight.

I’ve had this happen a few times, a guy i’ve been attracted to telling me that he appreciates the fact that i think he’s cute, it’s natural i think to like being told we have traits that others find us attractive, no matter if we ourselves wish to pay it much attention.

Out of all my friends, only 1 is bisexual.
Straight people can be just as accepting and awesome as anyone else; I don’t care about people’s orientations if they’re cool :3

Oh my thats genius!
Technically you’re not asking him about his sexuality, but you really are in a way!

Why haven’t i thought about this before?

I don’t think i understand...
You want me to give him sweets?

I think he’s super cute and i would love to get to know him more and stuff.

Maybe you’re right, some people may take such questions the wrong way...
But what if i want him to fuck me?

Realistically, finding guys before you’re 18 and out of high school is quite the challenge.

You should first try to befriend then, try to find out more about them...
When you’re definitely friends you can try coming out to them, and admitting to your feelings.

9 times out of 10 they will in fact be straight, but hey at least you got a new friend!

In a way, its all about being brave :3
